Name: ATTACK_ACTION_PARAM_ST
Description: Attack action settings for weapons and enemies: the ChrBehavior trigger action types, LookAt and bullet direction, secondary lock, blade homing and HUD alerts.

Fields.Name: Disable Param: Network Test Version
Fields.Description: Exclude from the NT version or mark the ones to be excluded.

Fields.Name: Disable Param: Release Version
Fields.Description: Exclude from the product version or mark the items to be excluded.

Fields.Name: Attack State ID
Fields.Description: ID of the attack state.

Fields.Name: Default Behavior Judgement ID
Fields.Description: Behaviour judgement ID used for shooting when the shot does not have 'Use behaviour judgement ID' set.

Fields.Name: Connected Part Slot Index
Fields.Description: When used by an enemy, the part number linked to this equipment.

Fields.Name: LookAt ID
Fields.Description: LookAt param row to use.

Fields.Name: LookAt Direction Type
Fields.Description: Direction the LookAt turns towards.

Fields.Name: Bullet Shoot Direction Type
Fields.Description: Direction bullets are fired in.

Fields.Name: HUD: Alert Display Type
Fields.Description: How the HUD alert for this attack is displayed.

Fields.Name: HUD: Alert Level
Fields.Description: Alert classification of this attack on the HUD.

Fields.Name: Can Shoot when Dead
Fields.Description: If ON, the character can still shoot after it dies.

Fields.Name: Lock Distance
Fields.Description: Secondary lock distance (currently valid only for NPCs). In metres.

Fields.Name: Lock Time
Fields.Description: Time until secondary lock (currently valid only for NPCs). In seconds.

Fields.Name: HUD: Incoming Shot Warning
Fields.Description: Incoming shot warning shown on the HUD for this attack.

Fields.Name: Exclude Trigger for Reload Input
Fields.Description: If ON, trigger input is blocked while the reload input is used. Gamepad only.

Fields.Name: HUD: Incoming Shot Warning - Dummy Polygon ID
Fields.Description: Dummy poly where the HUD incoming shot warning is shown.
